explanation: Strong induction on t written as bit b m = 2m + b. First gray(bit b m) = bit (b xor bodd m) (gray m), from bit_div_two and xor_bit. If t = 2m, then t+1 = 2m+1 and both codewords have high part gray m and opposite low bits, so their XOR is 1 = 2^0. If t = 2m+1, then t+1 = 2(m+1); the low bits are both not(bodd m) (bodd (m+1) = not bodd m), so the XOR is 2 * (gray m XOR gray (m+1)) = 2 * 2^j by the induction hypothesis at m < t.
